prompt: You put $1,000 away for 3 years at 10% interest a year. How much MORE interest do you earn with compound interest (interest left in the account) than with simple interest (10% of the original $1,000 each year)?
explanation: Simple interest: 3 x $100 = $300. Compound: $1,000 x 1.10 = $1,100, then $1,210, then $1,331, so compound interest is $331. Difference: $331 - $300 = $31.
